title: Kalvan
desc: Kemban abandons his adopted grandfather in a forest to die at the hands of an animal, so that he would be compensated by the forest department. But the old man keeps surviving, which annoys Kemban.

title: Thudikkum Karangal
desc: Balu works as a clerk in Ramesh's estate and is very loyal to him. However, when Ramesh accidentally kills Balu, the victim's brother Gopi becomes furious and decides to avenge his death.

title: Adanga Maru
desc: Subhash, a daredevil officer, raises his voice against injustice when he comes across a few politically influential people. However, when his family is brutally murdered, he sets out to exact revenge.

title: Sokkali Mainor
desc: A widow decides to seek the help of her husband's spirit when she sees the marital life of her son shattering in front of her.

title: Kodiyil Oruvan
desc: An ordinary IAS aspirant, who helps out many misguided youths in his locality and shares a close bond with his mother, takes on a huge challenge when he opposes a powerful miscreant.

title: Ragasiya Kolaiyaali
desc: A crime expert races against time to help Kerala police catch a serial killer responsible for multiple murders before more victims fall prey.
